name: spec-ingest-ocr
description: DEMO/REFERENCE SCAFFOLD: a real, pinned local OCR engine implementing the OcrEngine interface from src/imageReader.ts (see Spec-Ingest-Tool.md section 5C/7A). Separate from the core spec-ingest-tool package, which ships with zero runtime dependencies -- a local pinned ML model is explicitly allowed by section 7A, but it stays out of the core package's own dependency tree.
